nameEn: Retail sale of hardware, paints and glass in specialised stores
description: This class includes the retail sale of hardware, DIY supplies, paints and glass in specialised stores.
includes: retail sale of hardware: tools, screws, nails
retail sale of paints, varnishes and lacquers
retail sale of flat glass and mirrors
retail sale of DIY materials and supplies
retail sale of garden equipment: spades, rakes, pruning equipment
excludes: retail sale of electrical tools, see 4759
